dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: #Take care not to fall afoul of his deception, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You sure you don't want to go with us?

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: I fear that I shall be of little help. Come back once you have defeated that traitor.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: When that time comes, perhaps I too shall be able to amend my past regrets.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: I need your help...

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Haha. Well then. Where can this old one take you?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: We're good.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Indeed. Come see me once you have vanquished that traitor.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: If we can use the power of the scattered Symphony, we can reconstruct the aqueducts as they once were.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Tell me about the scattered Symphonies...

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: I am sure you have encountered the music recorded in the form of paintings, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: In the past, Remus's musicians would cover every rock and stone wall with their melodies.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: But these days, only these golden bees shall heed the summons of the "Symphony."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: I need your help...

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Haha. Well then. Where can this old one take you?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: We're good.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Alright. Find a way to repair the aqueducts first.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Now that the aqueducts are fixed, we simply need to release the stored Ichor in here, and the waterways shall be linked once more!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: I need your help...

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Haha. Well then. Where can this old one take you?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: We're good.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Good. Now then, link the waterways. I will play the music alongside you.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, you've come to see me?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: How are you doing, big guy?

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: I must thank you for defeating that demon and allowing the remaining souls to transcend. These deep waters are far more tranquil now.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Still, the dearth of those strange noises makes sleep a more tempting prospect, haha!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: I need your help...

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Haha. Well then. Where can this old one take you?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: We're good.

dialogues.speaker: Scylla
dialogues.text: Very well. Don't you forget to think of me more often, now!
